scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w packages/server" "npm run dev -w packages/client" "npm run dev -w packages/bot"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/client && npm run build -w packages/bot && npm run build -w packages/sim
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/sim
scripts.simulate: npm run build -w packages/shared && tsx packages/sim/src/simulate.ts
scripts.lint: npm run build -w packages/shared && tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p packages/bot && tsc -p packages/sim && tsc -p tools/pixelgen
scripts.pixelgen:compile: npm run pixelgen:build && tsx tools/pixelgen/src/index.ts compile --
scripts.pixelgen:validate: npm run pixelgen:build && tsx tools/pixelgen/src/index.ts validate --
scripts.pixelgen:generate: npm run pixelgen:build && tsx tools/pixelgen/src/index.ts generate --
scripts.pixelgen:render: npm run pixelgen:build && tsx tools/pixelgen/src/index.ts render --
scripts.pixelgen:repro: npm run pixelgen:build && tsx tools/pixelgen/src/index.ts repro --
scripts.pixelgen:prompt: npm run pixelgen:build && tsx tools/pixelgen/src/index.ts prompt --
scripts.pixelgen:import: npm run pixelgen:build && tsx tools/pixelgen/src/index.ts import --
scripts.pixelgen:export: npm run pixelgen:build && tsx tools/pixelgen/src/index.ts export --
scripts.pixelgen:audit: npm run pixelgen:build && tsx tools/pixelgen/src/index.ts audit --
scripts.pixelgen:demo: npm run pixelgen:build && tsx tools/pixelgen/src/index.ts generate --limit=48 --scale=6 --sheet
